questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.
options: I hadn't finished my degree when I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.
Only after finishing my degree did I realize the true value of a liberal arts education.
It was only once I had finished my degree that I understood the true value of a liberal arts education.
I didn't finish my degree until I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.
questions.answer: Only after finishing my degree did I realize the true value of a liberal arts education.

questions.question: The manager suggested that we should reconsider our marketing strategy, implying that it was not working effectively.
options: The manager suggested that we should reconsider our marketing strategy because it wasn't working effectively.
The manager implied that our marketing strategy needed to be changed.
It was the manager's opinion that our marketing strategy required revision.
The manager thought that a new marketing strategy would be more effective.
questions.answer: The manager suggested that we should reconsider our marketing strategy, implying that it was not working effectively.

questions.question: Unless the company invests in renewable energy sources, it will face severe penalties for its environmental impact.
options: If the company doesn't invest in renewable energy sources, it will face severe penalties.
The company must invest in renewable energy sources or else it will face severe penalties.
It is only if the company invests in renewable energy sources that it won't face severe penalties.
Unless the company faces severe penalties for its environmental impact, it needs to invest in renewable energy.
questions.answer: Unless the company invests in renewable energy sources, it will face severe penalties for its environmental impact.

questions.question: The new policy was introduced with the intention that it would improve employee morale and productivity.
options: It was hoped that the new policy would have a positive effect on employee morale and productivity.
The new policy aimed to enhance employee morale and productivity.
The intention behind the new policy was to boost employee morale and productivity.
The company expected the new policy to improve employee morale and productivity.
questions.answer: The new policy was introduced with the intention that it would improve employee morale and productivity.

questions.question: What I find most challenging about this project is not the lack of resources, but rather the complexity of the task itself.
options: It's the lack of resources that makes this project so difficult for me.
The main problem with this project is its complexity.
I'm struggling with the complexity of the task, which is much harder than I expected.
What bothers me most about this project is the limited budget.
questions.answer: What I find most challenging about this project is not the lack of resources, but rather the complexity of the task itself.
